lines.text: Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD for offering unauthorized fire, and only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests under Aaron.
The LORD told Moses to present the tribe of Levi to Aaron to care for the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting.
The LORD took the Levites in place of every firstborn Israelite, since He had struck down every firstborn in Egypt.
Levi's sons were Gershon, Kohath and Merari, and the Kohathites camped on the north side of the tabernacle.
To redeem the 273 extra firstborn, Moses collected ten shekels for each and gave the money to Aaron and his sons.
